usageNotes: Removes a specific node from an SDN fabric configuration. The caller must hold SDN.Allocate on the fabric path and Sys.Modify on the target node — both privileges are required simultaneously. This operation returns null synchronously; after deletion, apply the SDN configuration (POST /cluster/sdn) to propagate the change across the cluster.

examples.summary: Remove node 'pve2' from the SDN fabric 'fab01'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the node's participation record from the SDN fabric; any fabric-specific network configuration (routes, peers, VTEP settings) tied to that node entry is lost and must be re-added manually if the node is to rejoin.
tips: fabric_id must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters and cannot start or end with a hyphen.
Removing a node from the fabric does not remove the node from the cluster; it only detaches it from this SDN fabric's control plane.
After deletion, run POST /cluster/sdn to commit and apply the updated SDN state cluster-wide.
Verify no active SDN zones or VNets depend on this node's fabric membership before removing it.
